title: Imperfect
text: Imperfect. Mirror arrived intact all the way from China and was well packaged (although removing from all the packaging was a nuisance). No hardware, instructions, or template are included. A template would be a huge help, please consider adding this. The beveled edge of this mirror has a wobble/wave in the glass which shouldn't be there but it's far too heavy and complicated for me to return so that's why I'm only giving it 3 stars. It is very obvious when looking down at the mirror but after hanging on the wall it was less noticeable.

product_metadata.title: Howard Elliott Frameless Silver Small Hanging Wall Mirror, Simple Focal Point for Any Entryway, Bathroom, Vanity, Bedroom or Any Other Room in Your Home, 24 x 32 Inch, Round (12-Inch)
features: BEAUTIFUL FOCAL POINT - Round hanging wall mirror with no frame is a beautiful yet simple focal point for any entryway, bathroom, bedroom or any other room in your home
ACCENT MIRROR - With only a beveled edge and no frame, this beautiful accent mirror is elegant in its simplicity and blends perfectly with any home’s decor
BEVELED EDGE - For added detail and interest, the mirror’s edge is beautifully beveled
EASY TO HANG - D-rings are affixed to the back of the decorative mirror so it is ready to hang right out of the box!
DIMENSIONS - Decorative frameless mirror has 12 inch diameter
description: This piece is all mirror. No frame, no decoration, no finishes. Just its simple, beautiful self. It is a circle with a simple beveled edge. Alone or in multiples, the Frameless Mirror is a perfect accent piece for an entryway, bathroom, bedroom or any room in your home. D-rings are affixed to the back of the mirror so it is ready to hang right out of the box! Other frameless sizes and shapes are available.
